label: Whip Smear
blurb: Notices whenever the camera whips round, and only then turns it into a proper whip pan: the picture smears hard along the direction the camera is flying, lights and bright edges streak out further than everything else, and the frame leans the way a phone or a game capture bends on a fast turn. Walking, slow pans and shake are left alone, and the smear lets go a moment after the camera settles. Every whip in a long take gets it, in its own direction, with no keyframes.
